testsuite.name: com.chromascape.web.accounttask.config.StabilizationAuthFilterTest

testcase.name: loopback development requests are permitted when no token is configured
triage resolution requires the write token, not the read token
oversized request bodies are rejected with 413 before parsing
isFinished() reflects EOF, not quota exhaustion
read-only GET endpoints never require the write token
a missing token is rejected when a token is configured
blank tokens fail startup outside the explicit local-development profile
one blank production token also fails startup
when no write token is configured the read token covers writes
the local-development profile does not require tokens
a non-loopback request is rejected when no token is configured
repeated getInputStream() calls share one byte counter and never reset the bound
